Every upset meeting level≥2 contains the five maximal level-0 points and hence is dense (negation zero); nonzero proper dense generator closes to {0,a,1}. Four size-9 generators are L0\{x0^j}, j=1..4. The infinite conclusion uses deep-rank density lemma, not truncation.
